name: death_whistle
character: A skull-shaped clay whistle blown hard: a scream-like, noisy, rough wail that climbs and sags, not a pure whistle tone.
sources: Fruhholz et al. (2024), University of Zurich: replicas of Aztec skull whistles make a noisy, non-linear, scream-like sound from two opposing chambers (press release https://news.uzh.ch/en/articles/media/2024/Totenkopfpfeife.html; study https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11555264)
